# Code Anchors: Toolkit Location

- `libs/portable-tools/src/build-bundles.ts` — the one self-contained artifact published under the single declared binary name a caller addresses.
- `package.json` — declares that name, which is what a package manager links onto the caller's path.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/component-invocations.ts`, `libs/portable-tools/src/component-invocations.spec.ts` — enforces by-name addressing in every shipped body, and the narrowed form set after the second name's withdrawal.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/release-gate.ts`, `libs/portable-tools/src/release-gate.spec.ts` — the release-time precondition: no tag or publish while a shipped body still names a path.
- `libs/epic-resolve/src/classify.ts` — a capability its callers import rather than locate, its lookup retired rather than repointed.
- `libs/pr-worktree/src/worktree.ts`, `libs/pr-worktree/src/git-fixtures.ts` — a best-effort lookup yielding an empty answer on every failure mode, its non-zero exit inspected deliberately.
- `libs/workspace/src/resolve.ts` — a checkout declaring nothing for such a lookup to read spawns no subprocess at all.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/vendor-bundle.ts` — a capability finding its sibling files through its own packaging, never a recorded deployment layout.
- `libs/portable-tools/src/parity.spec.ts` — compares un-built source against a fresh build of the artifact published under that name.
- `components/commands`, `components/skills` — the shipped bodies that name the executable and a dispatch name, never a path.
- `libs/pr-acceptance/src/scenario.ts`, `libs/pr-acceptance/src/verify.ts` — the harness exception: no shipped body, driving one named checkout directly.
- `README.md`, `docs/delivery/release-procedure.md`, `docs/features/component-distribution/README.md` — the adopter- and maintainer-facing prose naming the one executable.
